name: SVW Heavyweight Title Tournament Final

matches.stipulation: Inaugural SVW Heavyweight Title Tournament Final
matches.note: Pain's manager, The Master of Darkness, slipped him a pair of brass knuckles; Conover blocked the punch, turned the knuckles on Pain, then won with the Figure Four Leglock.

notes: The final of a sixteen-entrant, single-night tournament (three earlier rounds held collect-only, not served or structured).

name: SVW Bunkhouse Title Tournament Final

matches.stipulation: Inaugural SVW Bunkhouse Title Tournament Final, no-disqualification
matches.note: Blake won with his finisher, a brainbuster/cradle-suplex combination he calls "The Recession."

notes: The final of a tournament run in the same week as the Heavyweight tournament (earlier rounds held collect-only, not served or structured).

name: SVW Alabama Heavyweight Title Tournament Final

matches.stipulation: Inaugural SVW Alabama Heavyweight Title Tournament Final
matches.note: The Bushman hit his own finisher but went up top instead of covering; Tre moved and rolled him up for the pin and the title.

notes: The final of a tournament run the same week as the Bunkhouse final (earlier rounds held collect-only, not served or structured).

name: SVW Tag Team Title Tournament Final

matches.stipulation: Inaugural SVW Tag Team Title Tournament Final
matches.note: Canadian Carnage's manager, Sir John A. MacDonald IV, pushed Seroch off the top rope; The Mountie II rolled him up with a handful of tights for the pin and the titles.

notes: The final of a tournament run the week after the Alabama final (earlier rounds held collect-only, not served or structured).
